description: facebookAdLibrary: Ad Details. GET /v1/facebook/adLibrary/ad. Get one Facebook Ad Library ad by its Library ID or ads/library/?id= URL, active or inactive. Returns adArchiveID, pageName, isActive, startDate, endDate, publisherPlatform and the snapshot (body, cards, images, videos, display_format, link_url, cta_text), with the advertiser's pageInfo and, for ads shown in the EU, aaa_info audience data. An ad no longer in the library is a 404. Ids are strings. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

get_transcript.description: Not supported: get_transcript=true returns 400. Use the video URLs in snapshot.videos.

trim.description: Set true for a trimmed response.

name: facebook_adLibrary_ad
